stock_moves_done_complete.name: stock_moves_done_complete
stock_moves_done_complete.value: "stock_moves"."status" <> 'done' or ("stock_moves"."done_at" is not null and "stock_moves"."category" is not null)

transfers_partner_required.name: transfers_partner_required
transfers_partner_required.value: "transfers"."type" not in ('receipt', 'delivery', 'return') or "transfers"."partner_id" is not null

customs_document_lines_values_not_negati.name: customs_document_lines_values_not_negative
customs_document_lines_values_not_negati.value:
"customs_document_lines"."package_qty" >= 0 and "customs_document_lines"."net_weight" >= 0 and "customs_document_lines"."unit_price" >= 0
        and "customs_document_lines"."invoice_value" >= 0 and "customs_document_lines"."cif_value" >= 0 and "customs_document_lines"."fob_value" >= 0
        and "customs_document_lines"."freight_value" >= 0 and "customs_document_lines"."insurance_value" >= 0
        and "customs_document_lines"."delivery_price" >= 0 and "customs_document_lines"."customs_value" >= 0

customs_documents_registered_has_number.name: customs_documents_registered_has_number
customs_documents_registered_has_number.value: "customs_documents"."status" <> 'registered' or ("customs_documents"."registration_number" is not null and "customs_documents"."registration_date" is not null)

customs_documents_values_not_negative.name: customs_documents_values_not_negative
customs_documents_values_not_negative.value:
"customs_documents"."cif_value" >= 0 and "customs_documents"."fob_value" >= 0 and "customs_documents"."freight_value" >= 0
        and "customs_documents"."insurance_value" >= 0 and "customs_documents"."delivery_price" >= 0
        and "customs_documents"."gross_weight" >= 0 and "customs_documents"."net_weight" >= 0
